svg.title: Editorial, operations and security cooperation
svg.desc: A: AEDAUT researches, writes, reviews and revises; ADOPT provides scoped technical support and contains Proseeker risk review. Shared handoff records article ID, version, reproduction conditions, expected and observed results, and evidence. B: a separate edition path leads from reviewed inputs through candidate checks to release and HTTPS comparison of one checked artifact, then revision and retention. C: content returns to AEDAUT; technical/security repairs to ADOPT/Proseeker; new decisions outside authority to Human Lead, with public summaries separated from restricted evidence. Revised to make the shared harness boundary, feedback and conditional relationships visible together.
